basic_profile.bio: Hey there! I'm a 30-year-old gamer from Chicago, diving into the world of Reddit to connect with fellow gamers and pop culture enthusiasts. I work as a graphic designer by day and spend my evenings exploring Los Santos in GTA Online or binge-watching anime series like Sword Art Online. I'm a bit of a night owl, so you'll often find me online late at night. Currently single and enjoying the freedom to game and watch shows as much as I want!

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I'm a self-taught gamer with a passion for open-world games and anime. I've picked up tips and tricks from online forums and YouTube tutorials, mostly focusing on improving my skills in GTA Online. My graphic design skills are honed through a combination of formal education and lots of practice on freelance projects.
